questions.q: Why is a drone's configuration code?
options: Whether it flies depends on it
questions.explain: Whether the aircraft flies depends on the configuration: you need history, review, checks, rollback.

questions.q: What should a commit message with a parameter change contain?
options: The change date and the author's name

questions.q: How do you check that a SITL failsafe test actually works?
options: Run it twice in a row
Break the config and watch it fail
questions.explain: A test that cannot fail proves nothing.

questions.q: Why normalize diff all before committing?
options: So the diff shows what matters
So Git LFS works with text

questions.q: Where should you store large binary logs?
What is a release tag in the context of a drone?
options: A label on the config you flew with
The flight number in the operator's log
questions.explain: git checkout <tag> -- <folder> brings the config back.

options: A rule checked on every config
A parameter that cannot be read
A configuration backup on an external flash drive
questions.explain: For example, “failsafe is enabled” — checked in CI on every change.

questions.q: Why have a second person review parameter changes?
options: To catch a mistake before the flight, not after
questions.explain: Fresh eyes catch typos and misunderstood consequences before takeoff.
